title: Social Media Marketing for Pet Shops in 2025

facts.fact: The Blackstone Infomatics blog post 'Social Media Marketing for Pet Shops in 2025' was published on 2025-06-27.

The article lists six content types that work for pet stores: user-generated content, behind-the-scenes moments, tips and advice, seasonal content, interactive features, and product highlights in context.
facts.quote: What Kind of Content Works Best for Pet Stores?

facts.fact: The Blackstone Infomatics article advises that video ads for pet products should be kept to 15 seconds or less to hold attention.
facts.quote: Keep it to 15 seconds or less to hold attention.

facts.fact: The Blackstone Infomatics article describes micro-influencers as creators with between 5,000 and 50,000 followers, whom it recommends pet shops start with.
facts.quote: Start with micro-influencers** who have between 5,000 to 50,000 followers.

facts.fact: Blackstone Infomatics states that it provides monthly performance reports so clients can see what is working and where to improve.
facts.quote: Our team provides monthly performance reports so you can see what’s working and where we can improve for better ROI.

facts.fact: Blackstone Infomatics states that its Social Media Strategy & Branding service includes monthly content plans.
facts.quote: We create monthly content plans with post types tailored to your audience
